what: a sheet metal body mirrored into a new body must still be sheet metal (flat pattern, bend table): it was a plain solid
method: T = 2, R = 2, K = 0.4, setback 4. One body: base 100 x 52, flanges 20 and 15 high (straights 16 and 11), all 100 wide, 2 thick, two bends of (pi/2)(16 - 4)*100/2 = 942.478 each, a 10 mm hole through the base (pi*25*2). V1 = 2*100*(52 + 16 + 11) + 2*942.478 - 50*pi. The mirror copy is congruent: two bodies, total 2*V1. The flat pattern of the copy must exist
